# Ze

> Open, programmable network OS for Linux. Ze speaks BGP, IS-IS, and OSPF, manages interfaces, programs the FIB, and gives operators a CLI, web UI, telemetry, looking glass, API, and plugin system around one coherent configuration model.

Built for people who want a network stack they can inspect, automate, and extend. ExaBGP users get a migration path to a more performant codebase. Pre-release: no tagged versions yet, built continuously from the main branch. AGPLv3 open source.

## Project

- [Features](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/features/): 44 features, color-coded by category
- [CLI Reference](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/cli/): 350 commands, generated from the live binary
- [Dependencies](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/dependencies/): 39 direct packages, generated from go.mod
- [Performance](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/performance/): Measured BGP benchmarks, not claims
- [Compare](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/compare/): How Ze stacks up against BIRD, FRR, and more
- [Activity](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/activity/): A year of commits, at a glance

## Labs

- [BGP Protocol Interop](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/labs/bgp-interop/): Real FRR, BIRD, and GoBGP sessions
- [L2TP PPP/NCP Interop](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/labs/l2tp-interop/): Ze as LNS vs real xl2tpd
- [PPPoE Interop](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/labs/pppoe-interop/): vs real accel-ppp access concentrator
- [IPsec / IKEv2 Interop](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/labs/ipsec-interop/): Ze as IKE initiator vs strongSwan
- [VLAN QoS Wire-Level Proof](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/labs/vlan-qos/): 802.1p PCP tagging, actually on the wire
- [Looking Glass Graph Demo](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/labs/looking-glass-graph/): Realistic UK topology, real external ASNs
- [Appliance Installer Evidence](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/labs/appliance-install/): HTTP/PXE, ISO, Ventoy, real boots
- [VPP Dataplane Evidence](https://ze-software.github.io/ze/labs/vpp-dataplane/): FIB, traffic, and firewall in a real VPP daemon
